d: Long, wavy ash-blonde hair is styled with thick, sweeping braids and a side-swept fringe, paired with small, vacant pale-amber eyes on a face with a youthful, adolescent appearance. The build is slender, dressed in a teal gown featuring long sleeves with white lace cuffs, an orange bodice, and a layered white lace apron over a voluminous teal skirt. Accessories include a sheer white lace veil held by a beaded tiara with blue gems, a matching blue beaded necklace, and a small, brown-haired rag doll held in one arm.
